info.description: Draft contract. V2 server qualification is pending. Existing v1 is separate.

PulseGRPCConfig.description: Omitted mode preserves TCP reachability. Health mode uses grpc.health.v1.Health/Check and requires SERVING, with TLS unless allowInsecure is explicitly true.

timeout.description: Docker stop grace, independent of the total operation deadline.

operationTimeout.description: Overall restart budget. Defaults to max(60s, stop grace + 20s). An explicit budget must permit the stop grace plus 20s.

priorityByColor.description: Explicit per-color priority overrides (-2..2). Shared emergency priority is reduced to normal for green and gray unless that color explicitly selects 2.

driver.description: Single recovery action. Mutually exclusive with rules.

taxonomyVersion.description: Required for rules. Pins failure codes and prefix expansion; changing it requires explicit configuration application.

rules.description: Ordered first match. No match means no intervention. Cannot be combined with driver.

notifications.description: Explicit per-color destinations. Blue reports an uncertain recovery requiring review and never inherits red destinations.

value.description: Meaningful only when available is true; units are defined by the containing field.

health.description: Current health is unknown while local preparation prevents target checks. Use lastObservedHealth and lastObservedAt for the preserved prior real observation.

actionsNeedingReview.description: Unresolved action holds, including historical incarnations. A conclusive non-conflicting review releases a hold without rewriting the provider outcome.

warnings.description: Non-fatal configuration advisories. They do not change observed service health.

configurationProblem.description: Local check preparation failed before target invocation. Current health is unknown; lastObservedHealth and lastObservedAt preserve the last real observation.

configurationProblemAt.description: Last failed local preparation, in UTC. Absent when preparation is usable.

lastObservedHealth.description: Last completed target-check outcome, preserved when current check availability changes.

lastObservedAt.description: Timestamp of the last real completed target check. Absent before any check returns.

maintenance.description: Controller-evaluated maintenance for this configuration and incarnation. Absent when a matching owner projection is unavailable.

notificationsSuppressed.description: Ordinary notification suppression captured by the owner. Gray control notices retain their documented exception. Absent when a matching projection is unavailable.

suppressionObservedAt.description: UTC time of the controller suppression assessment. Clients must not recompute maintenance from their clocks.

notificationConditions.description: At most 100 conditions in deterministic identity order. Inspect the original action for execution facts; no condition authorizes replay.

notificationConditionsTruncated.description: Conditions are omitted or detail coverage is unavailable. List summaries do not load retained review conditions. This projection never collects the whole action ledger.

notificationConditionsObservedAt.description: UTC time of the bounded detail read. Absent from list summaries and when detail coverage is unavailable. This is an observation, not a fleet-wide snapshot.

notificationConditionsSequence.description: Action-ledger progress sampled by the detail read, encoded as a decimal string. Not a resourceVersion, mutation precondition or resumable cursor.

NotificationGroupSpec.description: Ordered endpoint and recipient references. At least one member is required; groups cannot contain other groups.

ruleID.description: Guarded rule recovery precondition; required together for rule-based recovery. Not valid on other controls.

decisionRevision.description: Guarded rule recovery precondition; required together for rule-based recovery. Not valid on other controls.

configurationRevision.description: Guarded rule recovery precondition; required together for rule-based recovery. Not valid on other controls.

reviewRevision.description: Opaque action observation version required for a conditional operator review.

held.description: An unresolved action hold; independent of the recorded provider outcome.

executorFenced.description: Whether the original executor is known finished or fenced for review.

outcome.description: Recorded provider outcome classification, unchanged by operator review.

queuedAt.description: Original committed admission time in UTC. Retries retain this authorization.

notBefore.description: Earliest permitted execution time in UTC.

deadline.description: Original absolute deadline in UTC once execution starts. New notification conditions may wait with no deadline; retries and restart never renew a started budget.

startedAt.description: Time the execution start was committed in UTC; absence does not grant permission to retry.

finishedAt.description: Time the outcome was committed in UTC; an unknown outcome remains uncertain.

terminationReason.description: Confirmed operational terminal reason, independent of provider outcome. Empty when no terminal reason is recorded.

executionBudget.description: Captured execution budget as a Go duration such as 45s. For new notifications the first committed start sets deadline; absent means the original absolute-deadline contract.

openedAt.description: Time the unhealthy threshold was reached. Absent when unavailable in older state; never inferred from first failure.

firstFailureAt.description: First failed observation in this episode. Distinct from threshold-based incident opening; absent when unavailable.

notifications.description: Latest attempt state of each logical notification delivery for this incident. Earlier attempts remain in action history. Acceptance does not establish provider delivery or resolution.

note.description: Operator note recorded with the original audited event; never provider credentials.

actionKind.description: Original action category, when the event belongs to an action or notification condition.

outcome.description: Recorded safe outcome classification; never a provider response body.

executionRevision.description: Original execution revision, never a configuration or control version.

controlRevision.description: Original control or incident attention revision, when applicable.

endpoint.description: Original notification endpoint index; explicit zero is retained when applicable.

evidenceRefs.description: Opaque operator-supplied evidence references. CPRa does not fetch these references.

terminationReason.description: Confirmed operational terminal reason, independent of provider outcome. Empty when no terminal reason is recorded.

conditionID.description: Original notification condition identity, including cancellation before any closing action exists.

openingActionID.description: Original opening action referenced by a notification condition; does not imply a closing action or provider resolution.

id.description: Exact Kind/ID identity bound by the item MAC.

contentDigest.description: HMAC of ordinal, identity, source coordinates and exact transmitted resource-object bytes.

source.description: Opaque ordered source token; never a filename or URL.

changedFields.description: Preflight-only changed schema paths from the captured resource versions. No values or free-form map keys. Arrays and private maps are reported as whole fields; large changes use metadata/spec summaries. Omitted when unavailable.

outcome.description: Compatibility outcome observation. For collection execution, catalogDecision and childDisposition carry separate authoritative facts. Unknown future values remain readable.

committed.description: Optional catalog observation; true means a new mutation was accepted, false means none was accepted. Unchanged is successful without a new mutation. Omission means unavailable; null is unsupported.

applied.description: Optional retained child observation. Absent while the accepted child is pending or when no child exists; explicit false records a terminal child that was not applied. Null is unsupported.

kind.description: Resource kind for collection execution rows. Collection id retains Kind/resourceID; ordinary resource receipts retain their existing id form.

inputOrdinal.description: One-based original input ordinal, defining result page order.

planOrdinal.description: One-based original execution plan ordinal; independent of input order.

source.description: Opaque original source token; never a source path, URL, fingerprint or key.

originalUID.description: Original incarnation from the frozen plan guard.

uid.description: Incarnation produced or confirmed by the original catalog decision.

generation.description: Generation produced or confirmed by the original decision.

catalogDecision.description: Original conditional decision: accepted, unchanged, conflict, dependencyBlocked or unattempted. A child failure never changes an accepted decision. Unknown future values remain readable.

committedIndex.description: Original decision log index; absent for an unattempted input.

decidedAt.description: Original decision time; absent for unattempted inputs.

identityFormat.description: Versioned commitment to exact transmitted resource-object bytes. No JSON canonicalization is performed.

identityKey.description: Private per-frozen-collection HMAC key. Send only to the configured authenticated server. Never return, log or persist unencrypted.

sourceFingerprint.description: Private keyed source commitment. Source paths and URLs remain client-local.

contentDigest.description: Opaque keyed inventory commitment; requires the original frozen key and bytes to resume.

identityFormat.description: Present for collection protocol receipts; the caller must recognize it before uploading, validating or activating.

itemCount.description: Declared frozen collection size. Required by collection protocol receipts; absent for non-collection operations. Null is unsupported.

warnings.description: Advisory findings; they do not invalidate a configuration.

contentDigest.description: Opaque keyed inventory commitment; requires the original frozen key and bytes to resume.

identityFormat.description: Versioned commitment to exact transmitted resource-object bytes. No JSON canonicalization is performed.

identityKey.description: Private per-frozen-collection HMAC key. Send only to the configured authenticated server. Never return, log or persist unencrypted.

sourceFingerprint.description: Private keyed source commitment. Source paths and URLs remain client-local.

admissionTicket.description: Original opaque ticket returned by PrepareCollection. Keep it with the frozen input. Never replace it automatically after attempting Create. Expired or restored-epoch tickets cannot allocate new operations.

normalizationProfile.description: Optional versioned raw-file normalization contract, bound to the original admission and encrypted collection identity. Omit for unprofiled or typed-resource inputs. This field alone does not enable source reselection.

state.description: Parent progress/outcome. canceled and invalidated stop further decisions but do not imply executionResult.state is ready. Unknown future values remain read-only.

committed.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

applied.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

uploaded.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

validated.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

identityFormat.description: Present for collection protocol receipts; the caller must recognize it before uploading, validating or activating.

itemCount.description: Declared frozen collection size. Required by collection protocol receipts; absent for non-collection operations. Null is unsupported.

normalizationProfile.description: Original raw-file normalization contract when declared. Missing means no file profile was recorded. Unknown future values are read-only and must not be used to reinterpret the original inventory.

formatVersion.description: Current application snapshot format, distinct from node identity and authentication format versions.

commitIndex.description: Compatibility observation of the FSM-applied log index; not an independently sampled Raft commit index.

completedPerSecond.description: Absent when completed-execution rate is not measured; consult completedRateAvailable.

dequeuedPerSecond.description: Dequeued jobs per second; this is not a completed-execution rate.

drivers.description: Bounded per-driver admission and execution measurements. No target or per-monitor flow identifiers are returned.

awaitingReconciliation.description: Completed notification dispatches retaining reservations until owner reconciliation.

workers.description: Current worker goroutines, including idle workers; not a count of busy executions.

busy.description: Executions currently inside a job call; excludes idle worker goroutines and result publication.

requestedCapacity.description: Requested worker capacity before global and growth limits.

reservedCapacity.description: Sum of configured per-driver occupancy floors before the global worker limit.

drainingWorkers.description: Worker goroutines above supplied capacity while a reduction drains; these can include idle goroutines.

capacityCondition.description: available, growing, draining, or worker_limit; distinct from a measured SLO condition.

capacityAccountingAvailable.description: Whether the new capacity accounting is supplied by this server.

attainment.description: Compatibility alias for resultAttainment, a fraction from 0 to 1; unavailable when no expectations were recorded.

pausedMonitors.description: Current owner-observed intentionally paused monitor count; not missed checks.

pausedMonitorSeconds.description: Intentional pause exposure inside this rolling window, in monitor-seconds; this is a gauge, not a monotonic counter.

resourceOperations.description: Supported operations by resource; availability does not grant authorization.

notifyType.description: Actual notification driver key selected by the Code. Requires recipientRefs or groupRef, and excludes inline driver and direct endpointRefs.

trigger.description: Omission or state_change uses health transitions. Red rules may select recovery_failed after a confirmed failed intervention or recovery_exhausted after the configured attempt limit. Requires recovery. Unknown outcomes never trigger escalation; an endpoint with queued, started or unknown delivery retains its original action.

RecipientSpec.description: A notification contact with ordered references to typed notification endpoints; not an authentication principal.

AccessInfo.description: The authenticated principal and effective permissions for this request. Notification contacts are separate resources. Missing permissions never grant access.

role.description: The named principal role: reader or operator. Future unknown roles do not implicitly grant permissions.

permissions.description: Explicit effective permission identifiers, exactly matching case-sensitive OpenAPI operationId values such as CreateMonitor and AcknowledgeIncident. Clients must not infer write permission solely from a role.

ActionEvidence.description: Retained provider observation for the original execution, separate from its held outcome and operator assertion. No provider response body is included.

contentDigest.description: Opaque keyed inventory commitment; requires the original frozen key and bytes to resume.

identityFormat.description: Versioned commitment to exact transmitted resource-object bytes. No JSON canonicalization is performed.

identityKey.description: Private per-frozen-collection HMAC key. Send only to the configured authenticated server. Never return, log or persist unencrypted.

sourceFingerprint.description: Private keyed source commitment. Source paths and URLs remain client-local.

normalizationProfile.description: Optional versioned raw-file normalization contract, bound to the original admission and encrypted collection identity. Omit for unprofiled or typed-resource inputs. This field alone does not enable source reselection.

CollectionPrepareRequest.description: Prepare an authenticated creation ticket for one frozen collection before its first Create request. Preparing a ticket never uploads or activates resources.

ticket.description: Private opaque creation ticket; keep in client memory with the original frozen input and omit from diagnostics.

ValidationResultItem.description: Retained, safe validation metadata in original input order. Contains no resource bodies or credentials.

source.description: Opaque ordered source token; never a filename or URL.

change.description: Known changes: create, update, unchanged. Unknown values are read-only observations.

issue.description: Allowlisted issue code, never a provider diagnostic or source path. Unknown codes are read-only observations.

field.description: Static validation property path. Empty when a specific field is unavailable.

reason.description: Static validation rule code. Consumers preserve unknown codes as observations and render only known safe messages.

ValidationResultSummary.description: Immutable original validation verdict. Count is retained result rows, distinct from declared input itemCount. A successful plan is not permission to execute.

ValidationResultPage.description: A bounded page from one sealed validation result. Pending validation is a problem response, never valid=false. At most 4 MiB encoded response; default 100 rows, maximum 500.

ExecutionResultCounts.description: Scalar execution observations. Catalog acceptance and controller application are independent; explicit zero is available, omission of the entire object is unavailable.

processed.description: Original plan decisions recorded; excludes the unattempted suffix.

accepted.description: New catalog mutations accepted. Controller disposition does not change this count.

unchanged.description: Successful unchanged decisions with no new mutation or controller child.

conflicts.description: Original conditional decisions rejected by a conflicting version or incarnation.

dependencyBlocked.description: Original decisions blocked by their frozen dependencies.

unattempted.description: Original inputs never decided, certified by the final stop observation; zero while applying.

childPending.description: Accepted children without a retained terminal disposition.

childSuperseded.description: Accepted children superseded independently of explicit restore.

childInvalidated.description: Accepted children invalidated by explicit restore, separately counted.

ExecutionResultSummary.description: Immutable original identities, terminal counters and sealed result descriptor. Presence alone never establishes availability; consult executionResult.state.

resultID.description: Original activation identity; never regenerated for result publication.

outcome.description: Final original parent outcome: completed, partial, failed, canceled or invalidated. Unknown future values are read-only observations.

itemCount.description: Original input count; public pages follow inputOrdinal, independently of planOrdinal.

processed.description: Original plan decisions recorded; excludes the unattempted suffix.

accepted.description: New catalog mutations accepted. Controller disposition does not change this count.

unchanged.description: Successful unchanged decisions with no new mutation or controller child.

conflicts.description: Original conditional decisions rejected by a conflicting version or incarnation.

dependencyBlocked.description: Original decisions blocked by their frozen dependencies.

unattempted.description: Original inputs never decided, certified by the final stop observation; zero while applying.

childPending.description: Accepted children without a retained terminal disposition.

childSuperseded.description: Accepted children superseded independently of explicit restore.

childInvalidated.description: Accepted children invalidated by explicit restore, separately counted.

finalizedAt.description: Immutable finalization time; begins the retention cohort.

expiresAt.description: Retained result deadline, independent of cancellation receipt expiry.

ExecutionResultAvailability.description: Separate result availability, independent of Operation.state. Omission means the server has not reported execution-result support for this operation. Errors remain typed problems.

state.description: pending: original execution or publication has not sealed; ready: immutable pages are available; expired: retained result deadline passed. Unknown values remain read-only. A canceled parent may still be pending.

ExecutionChildDisposition.description: Controller disposition of the original accepted catalog child. Never substitutes for catalogDecision and never exists for unchanged or rejected rows.

state.description: pending, completed, failed or partial. Unknown future values are observational only.

outcome.description: applied, projection_failed or superseded; absent while pending.

updatedAt.description: Original retained terminal observation; absent while pending.

invalidatedByRestore.description: Original explicit restore marker, distinct from ordinary supersession.

CollectionReselectionCreateRequest.description: Create a disposable original-input verification attempt owned by the authenticated operation owner. The normalization profile must exactly match the original operation, including empty for ordinary SDK file inputs. Exact raw-source and ordered-resource identities are verified before continuation. Complete inactive uploads may be verified during validation; active and terminal operations cannot be changed by this attempt. This request neither extends the original operation expiry nor creates a replacement. Attempts are process-local and unavailable after restart.

id.description: Opaque attempt identity. This is not authorization.

operationID.description: The unchanged original collection operation handle.

normalizationProfile.description: The original supported file normalization profile; no parser source, key or commitment is returned.

nextSource.description: Next sequential source ordinal while input is incomplete; zero after all sources are complete.

nextOffset.description: Next raw byte offset within nextSource; zero after all sources are complete.

expiresAt.description: Fixed attempt expiry. Reads and failed requests do not renew this deadline or the original operation.

errorCode.description: Safe failure category; contains no input text, path, provider diagnostic or private commitment.

operationUploaded.description: Observed number of uploaded resources in the original operation; not an activation or execution count.

CollectionReselectionAttempt.description: Bounded observation of an owned, disposable source-reselection attempt. Source bytes include comments and unused text. This response contains no file names, source paths, item digests, source fingerprints, inventory keys or resource plaintext. Verification and remainder upload do not activate configuration.

url.description: Explicit A2A HTTP+JSON base URL. Management resources require credentialRefs.url; HTTPS is required by default.

token.description: Agent bearer token. Management resources require credentialRefs.token. Use separate authority for recovery and notification.

tenant.description: Optional A2A tenant. Must not contain control characters.

requestTimeout.description: Deadline for one HTTP request; defaults to 10s, at most 5m.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Explicitly permit plaintext HTTP to this trusted endpoint; defaults to false.

taskTimeout.description: Overall intervention deadline including task polling and receipt commits; defaults to 60s, range 1s to 5m. Expiry holds an unknown outcome without resending or canceling the task.

pollInterval.description: Task observation interval, 1s to 30s and no greater than taskTimeout. Defaults to the smaller of 5s and taskTimeout.

url.description: Explicit A2A HTTP+JSON base URL. Management resources require credentialRefs.url; HTTPS is required by default.

token.description: Agent bearer token. Management resources require credentialRefs.token. Use separate authority for recovery and notification.

tenant.description: Optional A2A tenant. Must not contain control characters.

requestTimeout.description: Deadline for one HTTP request; defaults to 10s, at most 5m.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Explicitly permit plaintext HTTP to this trusted endpoint; defaults to false.

timeout.description: Overall delivery deadline including the acceptance receipt commit; defaults to 60s, range 1s to 5m. Notifications do not poll remote tasks.

AgentReceipt.description: Last committed A2A correlation receipt. Agent text, artifacts, endpoint URLs and credentials are excluded. A task status or message acceptance does not establish monitored-service health.

sequence.description: Decimal uint64 receipt sequence. String encoding preserves ordering identities for JavaScript clients.

state.description: A2A task state at this receipt; omitted for message acceptance. Future states remain observational.

RecoveryFailure.description: Original committed recovery failure that caused this notification. Provider response bodies, targets and credentials are excluded.

terminationReason.description: attempt_limit, execution_deadline or permanent_rejection; unknown effects remain separate review-required outcomes.

AccessDiscovery.description: Non-sensitive process access mode. Discovery grants no permissions and never converts an authentication failure into observation access.

CollectionStorageAccounting.description: Sampled collection generation accounting. Cleanup conditions are separate from Raft admission health; unlinked bytes are apparent sizes rather than physical disk reclamation. File usage samples cover only ledger.db and generation.json in catalogued completed generations, not incomplete generations, directory metadata, Raft, snapshots, history, or host disk usage. Samples are incremental, not an atomic filesystem snapshot.

usageCoverage.description: Coverage of catalogued completed generations; complete is not a full data-directory inventory.

usageGenerations.description: Completed generations included in the known byte subtotal.

usageExpected.description: Completed generations in the current catalog.

usageOldestAt.description: Oldest file sample contributing to the subtotal; omitted when no file was sampled.

knownApparentBytes.description: Apparent lengths of the sampled files; omitted when unavailable.

knownAllocatedBytes.description: Filesystem-reported allocation of the sampled files; omitted when unavailable. Not physical host allocation or proven reclamation.

FailureDiagnostic.description: Bounded safe failure explanation. No provider response body, address, path or credential is included.

AutoIgnore.description: Suppress ordinary actions after this many distinct threshold-reaching outages in the rolling window. Both values are required.

window.description: Positive Go duration, at most 720h; no default.

active.description: Admitted invocations holding a queue lease, including executor submission and result handoff. Pool busy reports actual executions separately.

condition.description: Current scheduling constraint; not a health or SLA claim.

requestedCapacity.description: Configured timeout occupancy reservation including 15 percent headroom.

reservedCapacity.description: Reservation granted within current pool capacity; may be below requested capacity.

reservationAvailable.description: Whether the new capacity accounting is supplied by this server.

destinationConcurrency.description: Configured per-destination ceiling. Absent for check queues. Pacing and global allocation can impose smaller limits.

workerHeadroom.description: Driver concurrency allowance minus active work, before destination, sequence, pacing and durable admission restrictions. Not a count of executable notifications.

rateDeferredTotal.description: Process-lifetime count of queued admissions observed waiting for pacing, counted once per admitted copy. Not current blocked depth.

MonitorObservation.description: Read-only controller observation for a configured monitor. Has no writable configuration or resourceVersion. Health and controls are independent. Delivery counters cover retained actions in this incarnation; unknownActions includes retained unknown provider outcomes, even after review. actionsNeedingReview counts unresolved holds, including previous incarnations.

target.description: Non-secret target summary captured before credential resolution.

health.description: Current health is unknown while local preparation prevents target checks. Use lastObservedHealth and lastObservedAt for the preserved prior real observation.

completedNotifications.description: Succeeded deliveries retained for this monitor incarnation; not a lifetime total.

certificateVerificationDisabled.description: Explicit per-monitor TLS certificate verification bypass. Does not affect API authentication or recovery verification.

configurationProblem.description: Local check preparation failed before target invocation. Current health is unknown; lastObservedHealth and lastObservedAt preserve the last real observation.

configurationProblemAt.description: Last failed local preparation, in UTC. Absent when preparation is usable.

lastObservedHealth.description: Last completed target-check outcome, preserved when current check availability changes.

lastObservedAt.description: Timestamp of the last real completed target check. Absent before any check returns.

maintenance.description: Controller-evaluated maintenance for this configuration and incarnation. Absent when a matching owner projection is unavailable.

notificationsSuppressed.description: Ordinary notification suppression captured by the owner. Gray control notices retain their documented exception. Absent when a matching projection is unavailable.

suppressionObservedAt.description: UTC time of the controller suppression assessment. Clients must not recompute maintenance from their clocks.

configurationRevision.description: Runtime configuration identity for this observation. Not a writable catalog resourceVersion.

controlRevision.description: Committed control identity captured in this observation.

notificationConditions.description: At most 100 conditions in deterministic identity order. Inspect the original action for execution facts; no condition authorizes replay.

notificationConditionsTruncated.description: Conditions are omitted or detail coverage is unavailable. List summaries do not load retained review conditions. This projection never collects the whole action ledger.

notificationConditionsObservedAt.description: UTC time of the bounded detail read. Absent from list summaries and when detail coverage is unavailable. This is an observation, not a fleet-wide snapshot.

notificationConditionsSequence.description: Action-ledger progress sampled by the detail read, encoded as a decimal string. Not a resourceVersion, mutation precondition or resumable cursor.

cancelledNotifications.description: Retained cancelled notification attempts. Cancellation is not provider acceptance or delivery.

MonitorObservationList.description: Bounded stable-ID ordered page. Cursor freezes membership and incarnation identity; health observations can advance between pages. Start a new list to see added/replaced monitors.

ReviewNotice.description: A review-needed notification condition. Its closure does not resolve the underlying uncertain action.

ResolutionNotice.description: Resolution of an earlier exposed episode. RecoveredAt belongs to that episode; health describes the latest committed observation at start eligibility.

MonitorAvailability.description: Owner-published check availability. observedAt is the controller assessment time, never a substitute for a completed check timestamp. Pending means no real check result; paused means disabled or committed snooze; unavailable means local preparation or controller projection is unavailable.

observedAt.description: Absent when the owner has not published a matching configuration and incarnation.

NotificationCondition.description: Public condition metadata, independent of attempts. A pending resolution or held migration can have no executable action. Provider keys, target configuration and credentials are excluded.

kind.description: Condition category, including opening, resolution, migration, review_opening and review_closure. Review closures do not establish an intervention outcome.

pendingAt.description: Original pending condition time; absent when historical evidence provides no time.

recoveredAt.description: Verified recovery of the earlier episode; absence is not proof of health recovery.

ActionStorageAccounting.description: Cached action-ledger accounting. Bytes are encoded current rows, not bbolt allocation or physical disk reclamation. Unknown/review evidence and still-required dependencies are protected. Retention selection is bounded; cleanupBlocked is not a total inventory.

ordinaryRetained.description: Ordinary terminal records; dependencies may still prevent retirement.

protected.description: Records excluded from ordinary retirement, including unknown or reviewed evidence.

retiredBytes.description: Cumulative encoded bytes retired; not reclaimed disk space.

cleanupBlocked.description: Blocked records in the last bounded selection page, not a fleet total.

cleanupBlockedBytes.description: Encoded bytes of blocked records in that selection page.

observedAt.description: UTC time the cached sample was collected; a read does not rescan storage.

cleanupCoverage.description: last_selection_page: cleanup-blocked counts cover only the last bounded candidate selection.

compactionCondition.description: Safe background compaction condition; separate from durable admission health.

codes.description: Exact registered codes or terminal dot prefixes, such as tls.cert.*.

none.description: Explicit no-intervention decision. Exactly one of none=true or driver is required.

qualificationReason.description: Qualification from committed observations, separate from permission to execute.

RecoveryAdmission.description: Read-only policy assessment at observedAt. It grants no execution permission; writes and starts recheck authority, revisions, cooldowns and fences. Capacity and storage availability are reported separately.

deadline.description: Original execution deadline; absent before first committed start for new actions.

notBefore.description: Earliest time allowed by the observed cooldown; not a reservation.
